description: Rago catalog seed for Rally AutoGTM (vcglass, ex-VCPeer cold email / GTM automation). Meters outbound cold emails, AI-generated drafts, and credited card top-ups. Two plans: `gtm_usage` (the plan vcglass subscribes a project to by default, RAGO_GTM_PLAN_CODE; $0 metering mirror, because customers are charged through the local Creem balance) and `autogtm_growth` (flat monthly seat plus metered usage, for tenants billed by Rago directly).

billable_metrics.name: GTM Emails Sent
billable_metrics.description: One event per cold/outbound email actually handed to the sending transport (Postal). Counted, not summed.

billable_metrics.name: GTM AI Drafts
billable_metrics.description: One event per AI-generated email/sequence draft produced by the decisions engine. Counted regardless of whether the draft is later sent.

billable_metrics.name: GTM Card Top-ups
billable_metrics.description: One event per card top-up credited to a project's local balance (vcglass lib/autogtm/rago-billing.ts meterRagoTopup, sent only when RAGO_GTM_TOPUP_METERING=1). Sums `properties.amount_cents`. Audit metric: the customer already paid through Creem, so every plan charges it at $0.

plans.name: AutoGTM Usage
plans.description: Default plan vcglass subscribes each project to. $0 base and $0 charges: Rago mirrors usage (emails, drafts, top-ups) for the billing page and allowance checks; the money moves through the project's Creem-funded balance.

plans.name: AutoGTM Growth
plans.description: Flat monthly platform fee plus metered email volume and AI draft generation.

sample_events.note: POST /events { event: { transaction_id, external_subscription_id, code: 'gtm_email_sent' } } — one per send.
POST /events { event: { transaction_id, external_subscription_id, code: 'gtm_draft' } } — one per generated draft.

POST /events { event: { transaction_id: 'topup:<chargeId>', external_subscription_id, code: 'gtm_topup', properties: { amount_cents } } } — one per credited top-up (opt-in via RAGO_GTM_TOPUP_METERING=1).
